newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CMB sees steady current profit.
newsitem.headline: CMB sees steady current profit.

text.p: Belgian diversified shipping group CMB said on Wednesday it expected 1997 current pre-tax profit to be at least similar to that of 1996.

Finance director Ludwig Criel told Reuters after the annual shareholders meeting in Antwerp, "In current terms it should be at least the same as in 1996." In 1996 CMB had current profit of 1.02 billion Belgian francs.

Chief executive officer Marc Saverys said that for 1997 he was moderately optimistic. Earnings from dry bulk so far this year were below those of 1996. Gas and tankers earnings were higher. Liner services and insurance activities were slightly better and port activities were steady.
